m.chalisa.do1: I bow to Sarasvatī, who plays the vīṇā, and meditate on Gaṇapati. Kṛṣṇa, together with Rādhā, the great Śakti, grant blessing.
m.chalisa.do2: Remembering again and again all the hosts of gods, my guru and my father, I tell the glory of Śrī Girirāja as far as my understanding allows.
m.chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory to you, adored Girirāja, the revered great king of the land of Braja.
m.chalisa.cau2: You are an incarnation in the form of Viṣṇu; the whole world gives itself to your beauty.
m.chalisa.cau3: Your golden peaks are most splendid; hosts of gods and sages come for the sight of you.
m.chalisa.cau4: Your quiet caves are like heaven; there ascetics sit in meditation.
m.chalisa.cau5: You are the crown prince of Mount Droṇa, and you accomplish the work of your devotees.
m.chalisa.cau6: You won the heart of the sage Pulastya; with folded hands and entreaty he brought you away.
m.chalisa.cau7: When the great sage came into Braja with you, you saw the land of Braja and stayed here.
m.chalisa.cau8: Here is Viṣṇu's abode, lovely Goloka: the Yamunā, Govardhana and Vṛndāvana.
m.chalisa.cau9: Seeing it, the gods longed for it in their hearts, and took many forms so as to dwell here.
m.chalisa.cau10: Some in the form of monkeys, some of deer, some of trees and some of creepers.
m.chalisa.cau11: They enjoy the bliss of the abode of Goloka, supreme worshippers of the Lord's form and name.
m.chalisa.cau12: At the end of the Dvāpara age the blissful Murāri, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, came as an avatar.
m.chalisa.cau13: Śrī Kṛṣṇa told of your glory and set his mind on worshipping you.
m.chalisa.cau14: He called together all the people of Braja and had the worship of Govardhana performed.
m.chalisa.cau15: He had dishes prepared for the worship; the people of Braja brought them from every house.
m.chalisa.cau16: The cowherd boys together performed the worship; you took on a thousand arms.
m.chalisa.cau17: Śrī Kṛṣṇa himself appears in the worship and eats the food, asking for more and more.
m.chalisa.cau18: Seeing this, men and women rejoice at heart and sing the praises of the great mountain: victory, victory, victory!
m.chalisa.cau19: Indra, king of the gods, grew angry at heart and summoned the clouds to destroy Braja.
m.chalisa.cau20: Casting your shade, you saved Braja; not a single drop came down.
m.chalisa.cau21: For seven days heavy rain fell; the clouds, laden with water, grew weary.
m.chalisa.cau22: Śrī Kṛṣṇa held you up on his fingernail. Salutation, salutation to you, protector of Braja.
m.chalisa.cau23: Indra, lord of the gods, having acted in pride, grew weary and gave up; then he begged forgiveness and sang a hymn of praise.
m.chalisa.cau24: Indra said: Save me, I am in your refuge; Lord, forgive my fault.
m.chalisa.cau25: Again and again he prayed earnestly, and made the circuit of seven kos.
m.chalisa.cau26: He brought with him the cow Surabhi and the elephant Airāvata, and with folded hands presented his gifts.
m.chalisa.cau27: Granted freedom from fear, Indra was glad; he bowed and went back to his own world.
m.chalisa.cau28: Those who hear this story with their minds intent on it attain at the end the rank of Indra, lord of the gods.
m.chalisa.cau29: Govardhana is your name; you bring your devotees deliverance.
m.chalisa.cau30: Those who gain the sight of you have their sorrows taken away.
m.chalisa.cau31: Those who sip the water of your sacred pools: blessed, blessed is that human life!
m.chalisa.cau32: Those who bathe in the Mānasī Gaṅgā go straight to heaven.
m.chalisa.cau33: Those who offer milk and set food before you are never visited by sorrow of mind or disease.
m.chalisa.cau34: Those who offer water, fruit and tulasī leaves surely gain the fruit their hearts desire.
m.chalisa.cau35: Whoever pours out a stream of milk, his storehouse stays full.
m.chalisa.cau36: Whoever keeps a night vigil knows no sorrow, poverty or fear.
m.chalisa.cau37: The poet Śyāma says: In the form of rock you protect your own people, and give devotion, liberation and everything.
m.chalisa.cau38: Those without a son who meditate on you are blessed with a son.
m.chalisa.cau39: Those who go round you, prostrating at every step, easily cross the ocean of worldly existence.
m.chalisa.cau40: In the Kali age there is no other god like you; gods, men and sages all worship you.
m.chalisa.do3: Whoever reads or hears this Chālīsā with a pure and attentive mind, it is true, true, true: the great mountain comes to his help.
m.chalisa.do4: Forgive my offences, save me, Girirāja. Śyāma Bihārī is in your refuge, great king Govardhana.
